Auria provides solutions and software supporting complex space, national security, and cyber missions. The Software Engineer will support the Sentinel program’s Command & Control Embedded Software Team through all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, documentation, and technical collaboration.
Aerospace
Education
Space Travel
Training

U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Technical Contributions: Support the technical software requirements baseline, ensuring alignment with program goals and objectives
Teaming and Collaboration: Support fellow members in agile software requirements development, fostering growth in critical program efforts
Execution: Support technical execution in support of major program events, collaborating within and across the program portfolio
Systems Challenges: Support focus on resolving high-level systems challenges, ensuring the execution of the overall technical plan within the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS)
Strategic Initiatives: Support strategic initiatives on tools, processes, and cross-segment technical reviews, driving technical rigor into technical interchange meetings
Interface with subject matter experts, analysts, architects, designers, system engineers and specialty engineers to capture Sentinel Node structure and behavior across SysML/UML frameworks
Apply engineering principles to design components and systems using applicable standards and specifications, to include Model-Based System Engineering (MBSE)
Help develop technical content for presentations to internal and external stakeholders
Maintain software design documentation and follow configuration management requirements
Support software requirement decomposition, derivation, and traceability

Required
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related discipline
Minimum 1 year of experience on a project of similar scope or complexity (0 years of experience required with a Master's or Doctoral degree)
Experience with software programming and scripting in a C++, Python, Bash, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), type environment
Must be a US citizen with an active DoD Secret clearance, with an investigation date within scope (6 years)
Must be able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret and Special Access Program (SAP) security clearance within a reasonable timeframe, as determined by the organization to meet program needs
Collaborative contributor motivated by the opportunity to develop cutting-edge solutions that protect and serve both the nation and the world
Preferred
Experience with development drivers and middleware (RTOS, Linux and/or VxWorks) and anti-tampering (cryptographic, secure comms, logging, SW deployment)
Experience with Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) tools and processes, such as GitLab, GitHub, Azure, Jenkins, or Nexus
Experience with the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and a structured process driven software development environment
Experience with automated testing techniques including unit and integration testing
Experience with USAF Nuclear Surety (DO-178C, AFMAN 91-119, DO-330, etc.)
Experience with test framework/application and system verification
Experience with Containers creation and utilization
Experience with Atlassian tools (JIRA/Confluence)
Experience with JAVA/JS and real-time processing
Experience with Software Safety (Mil-STD882E)
Experience with CMake build system generator
Experience with Agile methodologies
Security+ certification
Benefits
This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees to work nine-hour days, which creates a three-day weekend every other week.
Relocation assistance is available.
Generous & Growing PTO: Start with a substantial paid time off package that increases every year you’re with us.
True Flexibility: Contract permitting, use Flex Time to work in a way that fits your life, not just your 8-to-5.
11 Paid Days Off: Enjoy 6 fixed company holidays plus 5 Floating Holidays to use whenever you choose.
401(k) Match—Yours to Keep Instantly: We match up to 4% of your contributions. Both your contributions and the company match are yours from day one with no vesting wait-period.
Industry-Leading Education Support: Level up with up to $12,000 annually for tuition and certifications.
Premium Healthcare, Lower Costs: High-quality medical plans paired with a Company-Sponsored HSA to help you save for the future.
Fully Covered Life Insurance: Breathe easy with life insurance up to $50K provided at zero cost to you.
Holistic Support: Access our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial coaching, and more.
